notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We noticed that some of you encountered an issue causing [b]world loading to be stuck at 85%[/b].

The team has identified the issue and designed a fix which implied rewriting some of the game core programming.
As a consequence, [b]previous player saves will become incompatible[/b], thus resetting the level (map) progression.

Workshop creation should not be impacted by this change. 

Thank you!

notes.title: ROAD TO RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hello Block fans,

Block Factory was initially introduced to you back in late August, when we launched our first Playtest. We gathered [b]tons of valuable insights from the community[/b] which helped shape the game to something more suited to your expectations!

[h3]What we achieved together[/h3]

We [b]worked hard[/b] on refining the onboarding process, to help you learn the specifics of our game more smoothly. We also improved some aspects of the User Interface, to be more in-line with similar games of the genre and [b]reduce friction[/b].

The addition of the Challenge Mode also offered another flavour to the game, players now have to scratch their heads and [b]optimize[/b] their [b]production[/b] and [b]workflow[/b] to reach new goals.

Things got more serious for Block Factory during the Steam Next Fest last October. We got [b]a big influx of new players[/b] and even content creators took some time to try the game out. The community also contributed in its own way, by submitting their own creations to the Steam workshop. 
This phase really helped us to [b]gather feedback[/b] and helped us to have a [b]clearer perspective[/b] on the road ahead.

[h3]The Road Ahead[/h3]

So what’s next for Block Factory? To be fully transparent with you, we initially envisioned an Early Access phase, to continue improving the game.
But thanks to all the feedback we have received, we feel more confident to work on what we already know, solidify the basics, create more levels to get ready for [b]a full release in early 2025[/b].


We cannot wait to show you the final version of Block Factory! See you very soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827680/Block_Factory/

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
First of all, we wanted to thank all of you who joined us to play the Demo during the Steam Next Fest.
We have seen a substantial influx of players and even more feedback on Discord and Feature Upvote.

We have dedicated our efforts to  bug fixing and to also overhaul one of our core systems: the Units Calculations System. It would not have been possible if not for your feedback. We have worked very hard on this and it has proven to be quite challenging from a development perspective!

So let's hear what you think about it, and let us know if some additional tweaking is required! 


[h3]Main Fix: u/m calculations rework [/h3]
[list][*] All units per minute (u/m) calculations are fixed and should be displayed correctly.[/list]
[h3]Fixes [/h3]
[list][*]Bugs while loading
[*] Random rotations in output items
[*] Gluer and Stacker not recognizing input
[*] Right click mass delete freezing
[*] Bug Conveyor + Teleporter[/list]
[h3]Improvements [/h3]
[list][*] Conveyor anchors: Now you can press "[b]C[/b]" while building a conveyor to place an anchor and make as many corners as you need.
[*] Star Goals Display: Any completed figure will show the stars required units per minute (u/m) when hovering.
[*] Re-assign figurine in compass at end of level.
[*] Paste over conveyors
[*] Undo recovers machine configuration[/list]

Thank you all for your involvement and feedback over these last two weeks, we'll be back soon, to have a look at your latest creations, we had quite some fun, but some of you really need to get better at this ngl).

If you want to to continue discussing all things Block Factory, come and see us on our Discord server!

notes.title: Block Factory Playtest Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We have now released our first major update for the Block Factory playtest. This update is shaped by the feedback and suggestions you’ve shared on Feature Upvote (our public board). It brings a number of major changes to the game thanks to the insights we’ve gathered since the playtest began!

Invites have been sent to all who have applied to participate, don’t forget to request access if you haven’t already! 

Save files have been wiped and all progress has been reset. 

Check out the full changelist here:

[h3]New content[/h3]
[list][*] New level: Dinner
[*] New figurines: 
[list][*] Tuna Sushi
[*] Omelette Sushi 
[*] Egg[/list]
[*] New machines: 
[list][*] Rounder. Use a Rounder to modify pieces and give them a smooth finish. 
[*] Bleacher. Paint any block white without dyes. 
[*] Burner. Paint any block black without dyes. 
[*] Double Cutter. This machine allows you to keep both sides of a cut figure, enabling recycling of materials. It must be unlocked through the Upgrades Menu.[/list][/list]

[h3]User Interface & Usability Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] The tutorial now has a button to better guide you through the steps.
[*] Added visual Hotkeys throughout the UI to help you navigate the game with more ease.
[*] If you click on the side panel "Complete Diorama" when you deliver all the figurines, it will now open the Diorama Window instead of centering the Diorama on screen.
[*] Added a Top View (Hotkey "T") feature to give a new perspective to the game, letting you see all machines properly without them hiding behind others.
[*] Dragging the camera with the mouse will now more accurately keep the floor under the mouse in place.
[*] Camera rotation now follows your mouse instead of setting a constant rotating speed.[/list]

[h3]Machine & Conveyor Mechanics[/h3]
[list][*] Machine speed is now represented in Units Per Second (u/s) to calculate optimal machine placement more easily.
[*] Most machine speeds have been tweaked to align with Piece and Dye Dispensers output speeds (1 u/s).
[*] Conveyors now behave more smoothly.
[*] Conveyors auto-connect to machines and other conveyors when placed adjacent to them.
[*] Teleporters now have a brief delay when receiving a piece for the first time, matching the time it takes a conveyor to move that piece from TP-input to TP-output.
[*] Subsequent pieces are teleported at the same rate as a conveyor (4 u/s).
[*] When making a big selection, the Machine Actions menu now appears on screen, even if the selection area was previously off-screen.[/list]

[h3]Upgrades & Machines[/h3]
[list][*] The Upgrade System of the Island Menu has been improved with the following changes:
[list][*] Added visual representation for each unlockable machine.
[*] Easier navigation and understanding of the upgrade section.
[*] Upgrade costs have been tweaked so you can upgrade more items.[/list][/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes & Performance[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed several reported minor bugs and softlock issues.[/list]


Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions, we can't wait to hear your thoughts and feedback on this update!

notes.title: Playtest Recap and Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’d love to hear your thoughts on the playtest so far. If you have a few minutes, please take the time to fill out our player satisfaction survey. Your feedback is invaluable and will help us enhance the overall experience for everyone!

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1mX1043i0s_xIAT1S6bbQQ9KQ-Xn0dtPEBM3i5Sr25ihtZA/viewform?usp=pp_url style=button]Survey[/url]

Our first update for the Block Factory playtest will be released later this week. This update is shaped by the feedback and suggestions you’ve shared on Feature Upvote (our public board) and through the insights we’ve gathered since the playtest began.

A lot of your feedback has focused on key areas like the tutorial, user interface, user experience, and controls. So, you can expect most of the changes to target these elements. We’ll be sharing a detailed change log once the update goes live later this week.

Additionally, this update will introduce a new level featuring three brand-new figurines. Stay tuned for more details as we reveal the new content. Bonus points if you can guess the theme!

Don’t forget to sign up for the playtest if you haven’t, the plan is to accept everyone on the waiting list once the new update is live!
